Segment-identity question. GEM's P5886 is named 'Shenguili-Pengze Branch' (18.5km, DN200, RMB 63.61M). A 2021-07-28 completion-environmental-protection notice (Jiangxi Gan'an Testing Technology Co.) is titled '江西省天然气管网一期工程湖口-金砂湾-彭泽支线（湖口-金砂湾段）项目' -- i.e. the OFFICIAL branch name is 'Hukou-Jinshawan-Pengze Branch', and this document covers only its upstream 'Hukou-Jinshawan section' (19.12km, DN500, EIA-approved 2016-05-12 by the original Hukou County EPB under 湖环评[2016]16号, built 2017-12 to 2021-01, trial operation from Jan 2021, actual investment RMB 80.83M), explicitly noting a valve chamber built AT 沈贵里 (Shenguili) -- confirming Shenguili as a real waypoint. This strongly suggests GEM's 'Shenguili-Pengze Branch' is the downstream continuation of this same officially-named Hukou-Jinshawan-Pengze system, using the Shenguili valve chamber as the segment boundary -- i.e. real infrastructure, correctly in the system, but possibly named/scoped differently than the operator's own section division. Recommend a human check on whether P5886's segment boundaries match how Jiangxi Natural Gas Group itself divides this branch (Hukou-Jinshawan vs Jinshawan/Shenguili-Pengze), since a mismatch there could also explain why the 2022-10 proposal/2022-07 EIA-publicity dates found for 'Shenguili-Pengze' don't line up cleanly with this document's 2016/2017-2021 dates for the adjacent section. Not a duplicate/existence concern -- the pipeline is real and documented; this is a scoping/naming question only.
